claim: A deleted VPC peering connection remains visible to the party that deleted it for 2 hours and to the other party for 2 days; if it was created within the same AWS account, the deleted request remains visible for 2 hours.

values.spoken: two hours for the deleting party

values.display: visible to the other party for 2 days
values.spoken: two days for the other party

evidence.quote: The VPC peering connection remains visible to the party that deleted it for 2 hours, and visible to the other party for 2 days. If the VPC peering connection was created within the same AWS account, the deleted request remains visible for 2 hours.
